name: NothingCN
description: Modern Next.js component library showcase with accessible UI components, live previews, and copy-paste examples.

paragraphs: An open source creative component library built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. NothingCN provides a comprehensive set of unique, visually stunning UI components with live previews and copy-paste code examples for developers.
Inspired by the minimalist design philosophy of NOTHING - bringing that same "nothing" aesthetic to the web with clean, purposeful components.
Zenit Digital specializes in creating modern web solutions and digital experiences. NothingCN represents our commitment to open source and sharing knowledge with the developer community.
features: 🎨 Creative Design - Unique, visually stunning components that stand out
🌙 Dark Mode - Full dark mode support with smooth transitions
♿ Accessible - Built with accessibility in mind using Radix UI primitives
📱 Responsive - Works perfectly on all device sizes
🔧 Customizable - Easy to customize with CSS variables and class variants
